$schema-note: Tier 1 of the design brief (2026-08-27) §3.1. Raw values only. Tier 2 reads these; a component that reads a primitive fails review.
$color-note: Color channels are [r, g, b] numbers, never hex strings. The generator writes them as space-separated RGB triples so Tailwind's rgb(var(--...) / <alpha-value>) keeps working (brief §3.6).
$palette-note: PR1 carries only the dark ground here. The light ramps still come from config/theme.colors, which is where every deployment's palette lives today. PR2 adds the preset ramps and moves the light values in beside these. The ground and bone steps mirror DARK_GROUND_RGB in packages/shared/src/theme.cjs, which is the code that derives the dark palette; scripts/lib/tokens.test.cjs fails if the two drift.
$scalar-note: Sizes are the two anchors of each fluid type step (brief §3.7). semantic.json builds the clamp() between them.
